effect.name: GM Channel Multiplier
effect.desc: Per-channel gain, per-channel gamma, a shared level stretch and an additive offset, combined four different ways. Multiply Gain is the straight per-channel multiplier, Additive Offset adds a constant per channel, Screen blends the offset back so nothing clips, and Overlay Boost multiplies but soft-limits the top end so highlights roll off instead of flattening. Preserve Luma rescales the result so a channel-heavy grade does not change the overall brightness. Built in layer space, so the grade rides the layer.
